name: browser-use
headline: Frontend Slides - Create Web Presentations
short_description: Create stunning HTML presentations with animations from scratch or convert PowerPoint files. Ideal for non-designers in operations who need to build web presentations without coding skills. Integrates with Claude for easy use.
author: zarazhangrui

sections.overview:
Frontend Slides is a skill for Claude Code that generates animation-rich HTML presentations without requiring design or coding knowledge. It supports creating presentations from scratch or converting existing PowerPoint files into interactive web-based slideshows. The skill includes 10 curated design presets and visual style discovery to help users build professional-looking presentations. After creating your presentation, you can deploy it to Vercel for instant sharing or export it as a PDF. Zero dependencies mean the output slides work standalone without additional installations.
Create a pitch deck for an AI startup with custom visuals.
Convert an existing PowerPoint presentation into a web-friendly format.
Generate a visually appealing presentation for a school project without design skills.
Produce a corporate slideshow that reflects brand aesthetics using curated styles.
sections.setup:
No install command available. Check the GitHub repository for manual installation instructions.
`git clone https://github.com/zarazhangrui/frontend-slides`
requirements: Claude Code or compatible AI agent
